I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated it into `config`, `fileutil`, and `handler` on the `feat/encryption` branch:

- **Streaming AES-256-GCM Encryption ([encryption/encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go))**:
  - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go#L35-L44) validates 32-byte keys (wrapping [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go#L28)).
  - [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go#L47-L60) writes the 3-byte header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), streams chunks up to 64KB with unique 12-byte nonces and 4-byte big-endian length prefixes (`nonce + ciphertext + 16-byte tag`), and writes the 4-byte zero sentinel + 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 upon idempotent `Close()`.
  - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go#L161-L185) lazily validates headers, decrypts chunks, and verifies integrity in `Read()`.
- **Encryption Configuration & Key Loading ([encryption/config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/config.go))**:
  - [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/config.go#L76-L81) validates `env`, `file`, `literal`, and `derive` key sources (case-insensitive) and enforces mutually exclusive source fields when enabled.
  - [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/config.go#L140-L183) loads/derives 32-byte keys from environment variables, files, inline base64 strings, or PBKDF2 passphrase+salt derivation.
- **Job Config, File Suffixes, and Handler Pipeline**:
  - Added `Encryption` ([`encryption.Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/config.go#L26-L34)), [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/config/job.go#L140-L142), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/config/job.go#L117-L134) in [config/job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/config/job.go).
  - Updated [`EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L43) and [`EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/fileutil/filenutil.go#L45-L48) in [fileutil/filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/fileutil/filenutil.go) to accept `shouldEncrypt` and idempotently append `.enc` after `.gz`.
  - Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/handler/jobhandler.go#L32-L67) and [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/handler/jobhandler.go#L70-L160) in [handler/jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/handler/jobhandler.go) to fail fast on encryption key errors before storage operations and pipe gzip output through [`EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cwi27rlt/encryption/encryption.go#L47-L60).
